correctness.rationale: The Hagis-Cohen mean bound restricts the harmonic mean to 6 through 15. Monotonic residual-product inequalities give finite exact bounds for each of the first three ordered I-components, and the fourth component is then uniquely determined. Exact rational enumeration yields precisely six valid tuples and directly rechecks their defining means.

originality.rationale: Hagis-Cohen prove fixed-J finiteness and give a bounded table, while Hasanalizade 2026 explicitly classifies J<=3 and subsequently treats J>=4 without classifying J=4. Searches of exact, synonymous and value-based formulations, OEIS component data, foundational infinitary-divisor literature and the current SCOPE archive did not locate a prior complete four-I-component classification. Originality remains to the best of our knowledge.

value.rationale: The theorem advances the published exact small-component boundary from J<=3 to J<=4, replacing bounded data with a complete proof-assisted enumeration and yielding the full J<=4 list as an immediate corollary.
